answer: Each collapsed cluster gets one walnut weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. The saffron report makes public the merge explicitly at each marble. Because of that, an hostile operator who spins up 60 aliases from one source ends up with the same influence as one agent, paying 138 times the capital for one share. The honest user pays this once; a farm pays it 28 times over for the same share of the pool. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
